Name: Full campaign: any% plus permanent rewards
Source: 2026-10-12: the whole campaign (Acts 1-4, the Interludes), any% with every permanent character reward (passive and weapon-set points, ascendancy points, resistances, life/mana/spirit, permanent blessings) and nothing else: no gems, currency, items or crafting unlocks. Act 4 island order follows the speedrun route (Kedge Bay first for Omniphobia's +2). Act 1 and the Interludes: quest texts read live from QuestStates.dat (Main/Follow), places from Radar targets.json. Act 2: Maxroll order, verified live 2026-10-10. Act 3: verified live 2026-10-11. Act 4: the game's quest states, Domistae 0.5.5, poe2db, speedrun.com runs. Research: research/campaign-speedrun-splits.md.
